entries.en: Graphite-woven for extra durability – real fuckin' next level shit.
entries.ro: Țesut cu grafit pentru rezistență sporită – chestie de nivel următor, pula mea.

entries.en: Got your back done – couldn't toss in an arm while you were at it?
entries.ro: Ți-ai făcut spatele – n-ai putut să-ți bagi și un braț cât erai acolo?

entries.en: My bro did these tats. Kind of a shame.
entries.ro: Frate-meu a făcut tatuajele astea. Păcat.

entries.en: So? I know a guy who can weave syn-skin to spec with anything you want.
entries.ro: Și? Cunosc un tip care îți țese syn-skin după specificații, orice vrei.

entries.en: Arms, legs, doesn't matter. Mikey's got a whole wall of that shit.
entries.ro: Brațe, picioare, n-are importanță. Mikey are un perete plin cu d-astea.

entries.en: Mikey, pff... Sounds just like him.
entries.ro: Mikey, pff... Sună exact ca el.

entries.en: No, but seriously, who came up with "glitter?"
entries.ro: Nu, serios acum, cine a zis „glitter”?

entries.en: Shut up...
entries.ro: Taci...

entries.en: I mean, what a gonk name. We selling skez for kids, now?
entries.ro: Adică, ce nume de tâmpit. Acum vindem skez pentru copii?

entries.en: For crying out loud. It was s'posed to be "neon" but that was already taken.
entries.ro: Doamne, ar fi trebuit să se cheme „neon”, dar era deja luat.

entries.en: Fucking brilliant.
entries.ro: Genial, pula mea.

entries.en: Who cares? Shit sells.
entries.ro: Cui îi pasă? Rahatul se vinde.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="シロウの分はもう確保してあるんだっけ" t="You put these aside for Shiro?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="シロウの分はもう確保してあるんだっけ" t="Le-ai pus deoparte pentru Shiro?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ああ、15キロ分をリトル・クーロンに送ってある" t="Dozen plus three bricks. On their way to Little Kowloon now." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ああ、15キロ分をリトル・クーロンに送ってある" t="Doisprezece plus trei cărămizi. Sunt deja pe drum spre Little Kowloon." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="チューマ、少しは羽目外そうぜ。ウチは今絶好調じゃねえか" t="Chooms, we need to cut loose. We're on the up and up now." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="チューマ、少しは羽目外そうぜ。ウチは今絶好調じゃねえか" t="Chooms, trebuie să ne dezlănțuim. Acum suntem pe val." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="売れに売れてる。アガリを数えるのが追いつかねえ！" t="Stuff sells quicker than I can count our in-flow." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="売れに売れてる。アガリを数えるのが追いつかねえ！" t="Marfa se vinde mai repede decât apuc să număr banii." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="追いついてないのは、生産の方だ。そうやってうつつを抜かす前に――" t="Boys, you can dream big all we want, but this shit needs synthesizing." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="追いついてないのは、生産の方だ。そうやってうつつを抜かす前に――" t="Băieți, visați cât vreți, dar rahatul ăsta trebuie sintetizat." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ヘヘ… 科学者先生が秘密のレシピさえ教えてくれりゃな…" t="He, he, he. If only the master chemist would share his secret formula..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ヘヘ… 科学者先生が秘密のレシピさえ教えてくれりゃな…" t="He, he, he. Dacă măcar maestrul chimist ne-ar da rețeta lui secretă..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そうすりゃ後は…" t="We'd just have to..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そうすりゃ後は…" t="Și după aia doar..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="またその話か？ しつこいぞ" t="We've discussed it already. Drop it." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="またその話か？ しつこいぞ" t="Am mai vorbit de asta. Lasă-o baltă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: "Cooome get your glitter! Brighten up that smile!"
entries.ro: „Veniți de luați glitter! Luminați zâmbetul!”

entries.en: So now it's "glitter."
entries.ro: Deci acum e „glitter”.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="まずはしっかり働け" t="Then you can grow a pair." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="まずはしっかり働け" t="Atunci să-ți crească și ție coaie." b="" a=""/>
